study type: Experimental animal study (in vivo and in vitro)
cohort: Asphyxia-exposed and caesarean-delivered control rat neonates were used to prepare triple organotypic cultures of substantia nigra, neostriatum, and neocortex.
finding: Perinatal asphyxia induces long-term changes in metabolic pathways related to energy and oxidative stress, priming cell vulnerability, and neonatal nicotinamide treatment can prevent these deleterious effects.
followup_time: 18 days in vitro (after tissue collection at postnatal day 2-3)
